entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie with VeloFit Support, how can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Order number is 788-B-451.

Okay, I can look into that for you. Let me pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see it. It was delivered 27 days ago. To start the process, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

It's not a fault. Look, I know I'm past the window. We had a family emergency. My husband required immediate surgery, and I was basically living at the hospital for three weeks straight. Then my son's overseas deployment got moved up. I haven't even had time to think, let alone mail a package.
I'm so sorry to hear about that, that sounds incredibly stressful. I certainly hope your husband is recovering well. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you. Please hold on.
Just tell me yes or no.
Okay... I've just pulled up our policy here. It seems you don't need an exception at all. Our standard return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery.
Really? I thought it was shorter for electronics. 90 days?
Yes, that's what my knowledge base says. 90 days. Since you're only on day 27, you're well within the timeframe. I can process this return for you right now.
Oh. Well, that's easy. Yes, please process it.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
